name: Citra
description: Released in 2008 by the Hop Breeding Company, Citra is renowned worldwide for its intense citrus and tropical fruit aromatics. It defines modern American IPAs and Pale Ales.

name: Mosaic
description: A daughter of Simcoe released in 2012 by HBC, Mosaic delivers a complex sensory bouquet blending dark berry, stone fruit, and vibrant tropical punch.

name: Cascade
description: Developed at Oregon State University in 1956 and released in 1972, Cascade ignited the American craft beer revolution with its hallmark floral grapefruit profile.

name: Centennial
description: Often hailed as 'Super Cascade', Centennial offers bright clean lemon and floral notes with assertive bittering potential. The cornerstone of classic American IPAs.

name: Simcoe
description: Patented by Yakima Chief Ranches in 2000, Simcoe is prized for its punchy resinous pine combined with lush passionfruit and apricot nuances.

name: Chinook
description: Released in 1985, Chinook brings heavy pine and pungent grapefruit resin, providing the bold backbone for West Coast IPAs, Porters, and American Stouts.

name: Columbus
description: Also known under the CTZ trio (Columbus, Tomahawk, Zeus), this variety yields intense pungent dankness, black pepper spice, and potent clean bittering.

name: Amarillo
description: Discovered by Virgil Gamache Farms in Washington state, Amarillo is famously celebrated for its sweet orange peel, candied tangerine, and soft floral tones.

name: Saaz
description: The quintessential noble hop hailing from the Žatec region of Bohemia. Saaz defines Czech lagers with its exquisite warm herbal spice and refined delicacy.

name: Hallertau Mittelfrüh
description: The historic benchmark German noble hop cultivated in the Bavarian Hallertau valley for over a millennium. Essential for traditional German lagers and weissbiers.

name: Tettnang
description: Cultivated around Lake Constance in southern Germany, Tettnang offers pure noble gentleness with subtle sweet floral and black tea herbal complexities.

name: Spalt
description: One of Germany's original landrace varieties from the Spalt district of Franconia, celebrated for rich woody spice and classical Altbier / Kölsch character.

name: Magnum
description: Bred in Huell, Germany, Magnum is celebrated by brewers across the globe for its smooth, exceptionally clean bittering profile and low co-humulone content.

name: Mandarina Bavaria
description: Bred at Huell from Cascade lineage, Mandarina Bavaria combines distinctive sweet tangerine fruitiness with German refinement.

name: Galaxy
description: Australia's breakout superstar cultivar, Galaxy boasts one of the highest concentrations of essential oils in the hop world, unleashing huge passionfruit and peach.

name: Vic Secret
description: Discovered in Victoria, Australia, Vic Secret delivers bright pineapple and resinous pine notes that shine brightest in whirlpool and dry hopping additions.

name: Nelson Sauvin
description: Named after the Sauvignon Blanc grape, Nelson Sauvin yields unmistakable white wine elegance and ripe gooseberry character beloved in craft brewing.

name: Motueka
description: Bred by cross-breeding Czech Saaz with New Zealand breeding stock, Motueka offers an exhilarating fresh crushed lime and tropical zest profile.

name: Riwaka
description: A cult favorite New Zealand variety descended from Saaz, delivering pungent, almost diesel-like pink grapefruit and saturated tropical notes.

name: East Kent Goldings
description: The aristocrat of English hops, grown in Kent since the late 18th century. Essential for quintessential English Bitters, Pale Ales, and Porters.

name: Fuggle
description: Discovered by Richard Fuggle in Kent in 1861, Fuggle imparts the classic woody, rustic English character foundational to traditional stouts, porters, and ales.

name: Willamette
description: Bred as a triploid seedling of English Fuggle in Oregon in 1971, Willamette provides gentle, rounded floral and earthy nuances for brown ales and stouts.

name: Strata
description: Born from Indie Hops and Oregon State University, Strata harmoniously unites luscious passionfruit and sweet strawberry with pungent herbal dankness.

name: Sabro
description: Derived from indigenous wild New Mexico neomexicanus hop stock, Sabro is instantly recognized by its intense creamy coconut and pina colada character.

name: El Dorado
description: Cultivated by CLS Farms in Washington, El Dorado is prized for hard candy sweetness, juicy watermelon, ripe pear, and stone fruit aromas.

name: Idaho 7
description: Bred by Jackson Hop Farm in Idaho, this variety brings robust pine resin backing bright citrus marmalade and lush stone fruit.

name: Styrian Goldings (Celeia)
description: Originally derived from English Fuggle in Slovenia, Styrian Goldings is essential for Belgian Ales, Saisons, and traditional British Bitters.

name: Sorachi Ace
description: Developed by Sapporo Breweries in Hokkaido, Sorachi Ace provides an unmistakable culinary herbal character driven by lemon verbena and fresh dill.

name: Warrior
description: A premier high-alpha bittering hop favored by commercial craft brewers for delivering velvety, neutral bittering without harshness.

name: Hersbrucker
description: A classic landrace German aroma hop from Franconia, delivering gentle floral spice and soft herbal warmth to Bavarian lagers and weissbiers.

name: Nugget
description: Released in 1982 by the USDA in Oregon, Nugget provides solid, peppery bittering alongside herbal woodiness suitable for stouts and barleywines.

name: Challenger
description: Introduced by Wye College in 1972, Challenger is famous for crisp, rounded English bittering and cedar herbal undertones in Bitters and Porters.

name: Target
description: A Northern Brewer descendant released by Wye College, Target delivers robust English bittering and peppery herbal tones for traditional British ales.

name: Northern Brewer
description: Originally bred in England in 1934 and heavily cultivated in Germany and the US, Northern Brewer is the signature soul of California Common.

name: Perle
description: Bred at the Huell Hop Research Institute from Northern Brewer, Perle provides clean, refined German bittering with minty peppery spice.

name: Sládek
description: Named after the historic Czech word for brewmaster, Sládek combines Saaz ancestry with higher alpha acids, delivering harmonious Czech lager balance.

name: Nectaron
description: Developed over 17 years by Plant & Food Research NZ, Nectaron offers saturated stone fruit and intense passionfruit character for modern IPAs.

name: Hallertau Blanc
description: Bred in Huell from Cascade stock, Hallertau Blanc displays vinous white wine and elderflower bouquet evocative of German white grape varieties.

name: Cashmere
description: A marriage of Cascade and Northern Brewer from Washington State University, Cashmere delivers silky smooth cantaloupe and lemon-lime subtlety.

name: Azacca
description: Named after the Haitian god of agriculture, Azacca burst onto the craft scene with intense ripe mango, sweet orchard peach, and tropical juiciness.

name: Krush
description: Bred by the Hop Breeding Company and long trialed as HBC 586 before being officially named in 2024, Krush delivers an explosive medley of sweet peach, ripe mango, guava, and candied citrus.

name: Talus
description: A daughter of Sabro released by HBC as HBC 692, Talus boasts prominent pink grapefruit, floral rose petals, rich pine resin, and botanical sage.

name: Ekuanot
description: Developed by the Hop Breeding Company and previously known as Equinox or HBC 366, Ekuanot provides a distinct interplay of bright lime, sweet melon, fresh herbs, and dark berry notes.

name: Loral
description: Coined as a 'super-noble' American hop by HBC (HBC 291), Loral bridges old-world floral elegance with new-world lemon zest and subtle dark fruit undertones.

name: Comet
description: Released by the USDA in 1974 as a bittering hop and revived by craft brewers as a 'wild American' aroma hop, Comet punches with assertive bitter grapefruit, sweet tangerine, and dank resin.

name: Eclipse
description: Bred by Hop Products Australia (HPA-016) and commercialized in 2020, Eclipse is famous for its unmistakable bursting mandarin orange aroma balanced by sweet resinous pine needles.

name: Enigma
description: From HPA's innovative breeding program, Enigma offers an ethereal sensory profile marked by white wine grapes, ripe cantaloupe, and tart redcurrant berries.

name: Superdelic
description: Released in 2023 by NZ Hops after over 10 years of development (trialed as NZH-102), Superdelic imparts sensational red fruit candy, sweet citrus, and tropical lollipop notes to modern hazy and fruity ales.

name: Wai-iti
description: A low-alpha aroma specialist bred by NZ Plant & Food Research from Hallertau Mittelfrüh stock, Wai-iti shines with crisp stone fruit like fresh peach, apricot, and subtle mandarin zest.

name: Alora
description: Commercialized by Hopsteiner in 2024 (trialed as HS-16660), Alora stands out for unprecedented levels of 3-MH thiol precursors and a lush profile of candied peach, yuzu, and apricot.

name: Vista
description: Released by the USDA-ARS breeding program in 2022 (trialed as USDA 2015011-003), Vista was voted top experimental hop by elite craft brewers for its gentle white peach, papaya, and honeyed citrus character.

name: Zappa
description: A native wild Humulus lupulus var. neomexicanus cultivar discovered in New Mexico and named in honor of Frank Zappa, this wildly unique hop delivers fruit cereal, tropical passionfruit, and savory botanical spice.

name: Cluster
description: The oldest continuously cultivated hop variety in North America, Cluster was the backbone of pre-prohibition lagers, historical cream ales, and California common beers.

name: Mount Hood
description: Released by the USDA in 1989 as a triploid seedling of Hallertau Mittelfrüh, Mount Hood delivers refined noble spice and herbal delicacy to lagers, bocks, and wheat beers.

name: Crystal
description: Derived from Hallertau Mittelfrüh, Cascade, and Brewer's Gold, Crystal is celebrated for its warm woody-floral spice and clean European noble-style profile.

name: Sterling
description: An American noble-type cultivar bred from Saaz, Cascade, and German parentage, Sterling exhibits classic herbal spice enriched with clean lemon zest.

name: Liberty
description: A half-sister to Mount Hood bred from Hallertau Mittelfrüh and released in 1991, Liberty exhibits very mild, clean floral notes and pleasant herbal spice ideal for delicate German-style lagers.

name: Ahtanum
description: Bred by Select Botanicals Group in Yakima, Ahtanum provides moderate alpha potential with floral geranium, earthy grapefruit, and woodsy cedar qualities.

name: Galena
description: Bred in Idaho in 1968 from Brewer's Gold, Galena was the world's most widely grown high-alpha bittering hop for decades, prized for clean, smooth bitterness.

name: Apollo
description: A super-high alpha variety released by Hopsteiner in 2006, Apollo delivers huge bittering punch alongside dank, resinous pine and sharp grapefruit when used late in the boil.

name: Bravo
description: A second-generation super-high alpha hop developed by Hopsteiner, Bravo pairs potent, clean bittering with pleasant candied orange, floral, and subtle cedar notes.

name: Hallertau Tradition
description: Bred at the Huell Hop Research Center to succeed Hallertau Mittelfrüh with superior disease resistance, Tradition provides archetypal German noble floral and delicate herbal aroma.

name: Spalt Select
description: Bred at Huell from Spalt and Hallertau Mittelfrüh parents, Spalt Select preserves the traditional spicy, woody-floral elegance of ancient Spalter hops.

name: Saphir
description: A delicate aroma cultivar bred in Huell, Saphir complements noble floral-herbal pedigree with subtle sweet tangerine, mint, and soft fruity refinement in lagers and Belgian ales.

name: Huell Melon
description: A daughter of Cascade released from Huell in 2012, Huell Melon breaks German tradition with distinctly sweet honeydew melon, wild strawberry, and summer fruit nuances.

name: Polaris
description: A powerhouse high-alpha cultivar from Huell with massive oil content, Polaris is famed for its extreme refreshing menthol, cooling peppermint, and icy alpine pine notes.

name: Strisselspalt
description: The premier terroir hop of Alsace, Strisselspalt is an ancient noble aroma cultivar prized for ultra-low bitterness and exquisite floral, herbal, and faint dark berry aromatics.

name: Barbe Rouge
description: Bred in Alsace by Comptoir Agricole, Barbe Rouge ('Red Beard') captivates brewers with distinct confectionary red berries like ripe summer strawberry and tart raspberry.

name: Bramling Cross
description: A cross between Bramling Golding and a wild Canadian seedling bred at Wye College in 1927, Bramling Cross yields distinctive hedgerow blackcurrant and rich dark fruit notes.

name: First Gold
description: The first commercial hedgerow dwarf hop from Wye College (1995), First Gold inherits the classic Golding floral lineage while delivering bold Seville orange marmalade and peppery spice.

name: Northdown
description: Bred at Wye College from Northern Brewer in the 1970s, Northdown provides classic British ales with clean, firm bittering and rich aromatic cedar, pine, and floral berry notes.

name: Styrian Aurora
description: Also known as Super Styrian, Aurora is a Slovenian breeding triumph derived from Northern Brewer that offers intense yet pleasantly balanced herbal and floral aroma with velvety bitterness.

name: Styrian Celeia
description: A triploid hybrid of Styrian Golding, Aurora, and a wild Slovenian hop, Celeia displays fine noble floral bouquets accompanied by subtle lemon zest and mellow herbal tones.

name: Styrian Bobek
description: Cultivated in the Savinja Valley of Slovenia, Bobek combines clean floral perfume with pleasant pine resin and lemon verbena accents, widely favored in continental lagers and English bitters.

name: Lubelski
description: The premier traditional Polish noble hop, Lubelski (historically Lublin) is an eco-type of Saaz essential to Piwo Grodziskie (oak-smoked wheat beer) and classic Polish lagers.

name: Marynka
description: The most widely grown hop in Poland, Marynka delivers assertive, clean bittering potential supported by herbal anise, grapefruit zest, and deep rustic earthy spice in Baltic porters and pilsners.

name: Kazbek
description: Named after Mount Kazbek and released in 2008 by the Czech Hop Research Institute, Kazbek was bred from wild Russian and Caucasian stock crossed with Saaz to create a bold 'super-Saaz' brimming with wild lemon, rustic pepper, and sweet berries.
